title: Larak and the River

mood.label: Heavy going, two fronts open
mood.summary: Two crises compound: the Himalayan flood toll passes a thousand with thousands still missing, and a month of Gulf quiet ends in strikes and $91 oil. A thin countercurrent - Libya's election deal, Lebanon abolishing the death penalty, a sight saved by AI.

lines: A thousand names confirmed by morning,
three thousand more still under stone.
The turbine crews went down at shift change -
the river took the light back home.
one surgeon's hand, one steady screen.
Hold the small light in between.
A month of quiet ends at Larak,
the tanker burns in Hormuz haze.
and Libya signs a two-year date.
